display.label: AWS RDS Database
display.description: Deploy managed Amazon RDS MySQL and PostgreSQL databases with high availability, security, and automated backups

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier for the RDS instance in the AWS Region.

sections.label: Engine & Compute
sections.description: Database engine, compute sizing, and credentials.

fields.label: DB Identifier
fields.description: Unique name for the RDS database instance.

fields.label: Database Engine
fields.description: Database engine to deploy (e.g., mysql or postgres).

fields.label: Engine Version
fields.description: Database engine version (e.g., 8.0.35 for MySQL or 16.1 for PostgreSQL).

fields.label: Instance Class
fields.description: Compute size for the RDS instance.

fields.label: Initial Database Name
fields.description: Name of the initial schema database to create.

fields.label: Master Username
fields.description: Master username (defaults to admin for MySQL, postgres for PostgreSQL).

fields.label: Manage Password in Secrets Manager
fields.description: Automatically create and manage credentials securely in AWS Secrets Manager.

fields.label: Master Password
fields.description: Master user password (leave empty if managing in Secrets Manager).

fields.label: Database Port
fields.description: Custom port (defaults to 3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL).

fields.label: Allocated Storage (GB)
fields.description: Initial storage allocation in gigabytes.

fields.label: Max Autoscaling Storage (GB)
fields.description: Upper limit for storage autoscaling (set to null or 0 to disable).

fields.label: Storage Type
fields.description: Storage volume type (e.g., gp3, gp2, io1).

fields.label: Storage Encrypted
fields.description: Enable KMS encryption at rest for the database storage.

fields.label: KMS Key ARN
fields.description: Custom KMS key ARN for storage encryption (leave empty for AWS default).

sections.label: Networking & Security
sections.description: VPC, Subnet groups, and Security Group ingress rules.

fields.label: VPC
fields.description: The VPC where the RDS database and security group reside.

fields.label: Subnet IDs
fields.description: Subnet IDs spanning multiple Availability Zones for the DB subnet group.

fields.label: Create DB Subnet Group
fields.description: Whether to automatically create a dedicated DB subnet group.

fields.label: Create Security Group
fields.description: Whether to create a dedicated security group for the RDS instance.

fields.label: Allowed CIDR Blocks
fields.description: IPv4 CIDR blocks permitted to connect to the database port.

fields.label: Allowed Security Group IDs
fields.description: Source security groups permitted to connect to the database port.

fields.label: Multi-AZ Deployment
fields.description: Provision high-availability standby replica in a different AZ.

fields.label: Publicly Accessible
fields.description: Whether the database is accessible from the public internet.

sections.label: Backups & Maintenance
sections.description: Automated backups, retention periods, and deletion safeguards.

fields.label: Backup Retention Period (Days)
fields.description: Number of days automated backups are retained (0 to 35).

fields.label: Backup Window (UTC)
fields.description: Daily window for automated backups.

fields.label: Maintenance Window (UTC)
fields.description: Weekly window for database maintenance.

fields.label: Skip Final Snapshot
fields.description: Whether to skip taking a snapshot before deleting the database.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.description: Protect the database from accidental deletion.

fields.label: Auto Minor Version Upgrade
fields.description: Automatically apply minor engine version updates during maintenance.

sections.label: Monitoring & Logs
sections.description: Enhanced Monitoring, Performance Insights, and CloudWatch logs.

fields.label: Enhanced Monitoring Interval (seconds)
fields.description: Frequency of metrics collection (0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60).

fields.label: Create Monitoring IAM Role
fields.description: Automatically create IAM role for RDS Enhanced Monitoring.

fields.label: Performance Insights Enabled
fields.description: Collect detailed database query execution metrics.

fields.label: CloudWatch Logs Exports
fields.description: Log types to publish to CloudWatch.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for billing and governance.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to resources.
